data: Which line in the left graph has the highest value at 1 iteration?

The left graph is labeled as CHiME3. The lines represent different optimization schemes for WPE+MPDR and WPE+wMPDR. The legend indicates three lines: one for WPE+MPDR (separate opt.), another for WPE+wMPDR (joint opt.), and the third for WPE+wMPDR (separate opt.). The y-axis represents WERs in percentages. At 1 iteration, the line for WPE+MPDR (separate opt.) appears to have the highest value among all the lines. Therefore, the answer is the line representing WPE+MPDR (separate opt.).
